僧.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 人 (person) + phonetic 曾 — the kind of person meant is a Buddhist monk.
僧.source: English Wiktionary, "僧" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E5%83%A7#Translingual

層.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 尸 (a building) + phonetic 曾 — the tiers of a building, a storey; a layer.
層.source: English Wiktionary, "層" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E5%B1%A4#Translingual

志.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 心 (heart) + phonetic — historically 之 (to go), its top now written 士. The heart's direction: one's will.
志.source: English Wiktionary, "志" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E5%BF%97#Translingual

憎.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 心 (heart) + phonetic 曾 — a feeling of the heart: to hate.

懲.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 心 (heart) + phonetic 徵 (now written 徴) — to chastise so the heart takes warning.
懲.source: English Wiktionary, "懲" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E6%87%B2#Translingual

戻.originText: Ideogrammic compound: 戶 (door) over 犬 (dog) — a dog twisting back under a door, hence to return. The dog is now drawn 大.
戻.source: English Wiktionary, "戻" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E6%88%BB#Translingual

房.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 戶 (door) + phonetic 方 — a side room off the main hall.

所.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 斤 (axe) + phonetic 戶 — originally the sound of chopping; now means a place.
所.source: English Wiktionary, "所" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E6%89%80#Translingual

扇.originText: Ideogrammic compound: semantic 戶 (door) + semantic 羽 (feathers) — a door-leaf of feathers, a fan.

扉.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 戶 (door) + phonetic 非 — a door-leaf.
扉.source: English Wiktionary, "扉" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E6%89%89#Translingual

捨.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 手 (hand) + phonetic 舍 — to let go with the hand, to discard.

時.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 日 (sun; day) + phonetic — historically 之 (to go), the passing of the days. The phonetic component later changed to 寺.
時.source: English Wiktionary, "時" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E6%99%82#Translingual

磨.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 石 (rock) + phonetic 麻 — to grind against stone. (Older forms wrote the phonetic as 靡.)

簡.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 竹 (bamboo) + phonetic 間 (older 閒) — a bamboo writing-slip; hence brief, simple.
簡.source: English Wiktionary, "簡" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E7%B0%A1#Translingual

緻.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 糸 (thread) + phonetic 致 — closely woven, fine.
緻.source: English Wiktionary, "緻" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E7%B7%BB#Translingual

虞.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 虍 (tiger) + phonetic 吳 (now written 呉).

誤.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 言 (speech) + phonetic 吳 (now written 呉) — to speak in error.
誤.source: English Wiktionary, "誤" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E8%AA%A4#Translingual

賞.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 貝 (cowry; money) + phonetic 尚 (its seal form was 商) — to award with money, a reward.
賞.source: English Wiktionary, "賞" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E8%B3%9E#Translingual

贈.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 貝 (cowry; money) + phonetic 曾 — to present a gift.
贈.source: English Wiktionary, "贈" (Translingual, Glyph origin), CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E8%B4%88#Translingual

起.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 走 (to run) + phonetic — historically 巳, now written 己 — to rise and set off.

雇.originText: Phono-semantic compound: semantic 隹 (bird) + phonetic 戶 — originally a migratory bird; later, to hire.
